facts.business: Manaksia Steels Limited is a multi-product light engineering company based in Kolkata that specialises in producing value-added flat steel products such as galvanized, Alu-Zinc coated and colour-coated steel for India's housing, infrastructure, industrial and warehousing sectors.

segments.name: Value-added flat steel products (galvanized, Alu-Zinc coated, colour-coated)

auditor.name: S K AGRAWAL AND CO CHARTERED ACCOUNTANTS LLP

facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions include sale of goods to entities where KMP/Directors have significant influence (Rs 20,501.21 lacs in FY26), purchase of goods (Rs 984.50 lacs), salary to KMPs (Rs 497.43 lacs), and meeting fees (Rs 4.95 lacs). Subsidiaries include Federated Steel Mills Limited, Far East Steel Industries Limited, and Sumo Agrochem Limited (all Nigeria, 100% held). Technomet International FZE ceased to be a subsidiary w.e.f 10th July 2024.
